review.images: Checked Emaar’s eight gallery scenes and the wide hero. Used eight distinct views after omitting the narrower repeated aerial view. The three-tower hero supplies the listing card. The editorial images show a residence living room and bedroom.
review.location: Checked the Palace Residences project point, regional map and the four published travel estimates on physical brochure page 4. The 25-minute item is District 2020 on this project’s brochure.
review.floorPlans: Used 35 full sheets in Emaar’s 36-page Building 1 and townhouse PDF, 30 in the Emaar Building 2 original via Petkovic Properties, and 34 full Emaar-branded sheet images from Homeland Realty’s Building 3 catalogue. Checked all 52 and 41 PDF area tables visually and against independent extraction. Checked 56 image tables visually, compared the unit leads and layout types with the broker catalogue, and verified the arithmetic. The local Building 3 image links preserve the available broker source without alteration. The single Emaar sales sheet for Building 2 Type B.2 corroborates the mirrored pack.

unavailable: An original Building 3 PDF pack, signed unit areas and entrance coordinates were not verified.
